test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Q, R, S, T, U, V, W and X are sitting around a square table facing the center of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners while some are sitting at the exact center of the sides. X sits second to the left of W. W sits in one of the corners. V is the immediate neighbour of T and U. R. sits third to the left of T. U does not sit in one of the corners. U is neither the neighbour of X nor W. Q is not the neighbour of X.

How many people sit between S and V, when counted from the left of S?
solution:
Given :

 
• Q, R, S, T, U, V, W and X are sitting around a square table facing the center of the table.
 
• Some of them are sitting at the corners while some are sitting at the exact center of the sides.

Explanation :

1) W sits in one of the corners.

2) X sits second to the left of W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07dcbe0615734389c0d59c1a36e4f6efa140864558403816dbdde3f16f68bca5.png] 

3) U does not sit in one of the corners.

4) V is the immediate neighbour of T and U.

As position of V is not know yet therefore there possible positions for V.

 
• Case - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00e2affe5f15bea3d7f16406c937e66ca5869ff7e8e80d575c0520242eb7d773.png] 

 
• Case - (2) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cfb1b42c4926fa04d5d34fd838cd58f38f0e27e2e27bd509de9ff31bebea69e1.png] 

5) R sits third to the left of T.

6) U is neither the neighbour of X nor W.

7) Q is not the neighbour of X.

As there is no possible position for R in case - (2) therefore, case - (2) is eliminated.

After positioning R and Q only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e S.

 
• Case - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3b85b092b8dbb26c81898b07cfd4fa4ef8c5919906f85d5512cf34252009360.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement two people i.e X and T sit between S and V, when counted from the left of S.

Hence, "Two" is the correct answer.
